verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit's FAQ documents data retention controls covering code-related data such as learnings and review context, plus a separately controllable model output logging setting. However, full opt-out of retention is stated only for self-hosted Enterprise, and the evidence does not document how to delete data. missing for 10: explicit data deletion/purge capability, details of retention controls on the cloud (non-Enterprise) offering, configurable retention periods, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: Data retention only affects storage of code-related data such as learnings and review context
On self-hosted CodeRabbit (available for Enterprise), you can opt out of all data retention at any time
